metadata.name: OpenBEXI Timeline 2.9 plugin architecture
metadata.purpose: HBDS structure for workspaces, reusable ingestion plugins, shared execution, durable publication and unchanged timeline display.

timeline.status: Implemented 2.9 domain model. Runtime schemas validate namespace, service and plugin files independently.
timeline.cardinalityNotation: source = sources per target; target = targets per source. Composition declares ownership. Workspace namespace membership is a reference, so separate workspaces may reuse a namespace.
timeline.attributeNotation: Typed attributes carry full JSON Schema under extensions.timeline.jsonSchema. Plugin and job contract API version is 1.

meanings.admin: Read/write namespace data and manage that namespace configuration and grants.
meanings.rw: Read/write namespace records; no access-management permission.
meanings.r: Read namespace records and configuration needed to display them.

accessPolicy.effectivePermission: The lesser of Role.ceiling and the unique GroupNamespaceAccess.permission for User.groupId and the namespace; missing grant is denied.
accessPolicy.administratorFlag: User.admin enables global user/group administration only with Role.ceiling=admin. It does not bypass a missing or denied namespace grant.
accessPolicy.conflictPolicy: Duplicate group+namespace grants are invalid, not merged. Unknown permissions fail closed. Explicit denied always denies.
accessPolicy.legacyPermission: Source.permission is preserved verbatim for YAML compatibility; neither blank nor unknown legacy strings create authorization grants.

rendering.description: Optional rendering settings. Omitted properties retain the existing presentation.

theme.description: Scene and optional application surface colors.

sceneBackgroundImage.description: Optional same-origin image URL, relative to the hosting page. Stretched to the background; null keeps the color.

headerBackground.description: Header background; null keeps the stylesheet theme.

panelBackground.description: Timeline panel background; null keeps the stylesheet theme.

panelText.description: Panel text color; null keeps the stylesheet theme.

axis.description: Date axes and automatic tick spacing.

verticalPadding.description: Additional axis height above the band font size.

minimumFontSize.description: Minimum canvas date-label font size in pixels.

targetTickPixels.description: Preferred distance between automatically chosen time labels.

groupHeaderHeight.description: Space reserved for a group heading.

overview.description: Overview SVG labels, markers and visible-range indicators.

dimmedOpacity.description: Opacity multiplier for nonmatching records during search.

camera.description: 3D camera and lighting. The UI starts in 2D; the model editor can preview either mode.

mode.description: Camera mode for model preview. Page startup always uses 2D.

fieldOfView.description: Perspective field of view in degrees.

yaw.description: Initial horizontal orbit angle in radians.

pitch.description: Initial vertical orbit angle in radians.

rotationSensitivity.description: Orbit rotation sensitivity; 0.002 is the default speed.

activity.description: Activity labels, 3D materials and selection brightness. Selection never enlarges activities.

glowPulse.description: Additional glow opacity during the selection pulse.

transitionMs.description: Selection pulse duration; zero disables animation.

layout.description: Responsive layout preferences; computed positions and page membership are not persisted.

sidebarBreakpoint.description: Viewport width below which the Data panel overlays the plot.

sidebarDefaultRatio.description: Initial Data panel width relative to the viewport.

sidebarMaximumRatio.description: Maximum docked Data panel width relative to the viewport.

minimumPlotWidth.description: Space retained next to a docked Data panel.

splitRatio.description: Timeline share of the split view width.

interaction.description: Initial search preferences and user navigation increments. Saved/URL state still takes precedence.

resizeStep.description: Data panel keyboard resize step in pixels.

controls.description: Labels for existing, approved view and overview actions.

columns.description: Columns in display order; field is a supported record value.

dateAxisMode.description: shared shows one date axis at the top of each visible page; per-band shows each main band's axis using intervalUnitPos. Overview keeps its independent context axis.

fullWindow.description: Fill available browser space; false uses custom geometry bounded by the viewport.

backgroundImage.description: Optional same-origin image URL, relative to the hosting page. Stretched to the background; null keeps the color.

examples.status: Configuration view for 2.9, generated from the implemented workspace, namespace and plugin files.
invariants: GEO is a workspace containing earthquake and volcano namespaces, using distinct converter packages.
A namespace owns source instances and may select multiple plugin types; a plugin may serve multiple namespaces.
Existing default_namespace_id is retained as a namespace fallback; the multi-namespace UI initially shows All.
NONE serves existing materialized JSON without conversion. timeline_json validates incoming compatible JSON.
Live /data and operational outputs stay local; only reviewed static demo fixtures are public.
The core owns publication and checkpoints. CLI and UI share runtime logic and cross-process leases.
A repeated job never duplicates stable records or erases another source contribution.
New job IDs differ between runs; stable event/session IDs do not include plugin version or run ID.
Historical and numeric demo date representations remain unchanged.
A public package must work when private plugins are absent.
Architecture validation and application regression evidence are separate release checks.

class.name: Workspace
class.description: Selects namespace YAML files and a shared service. GEO remains a workspace with earthquake and volcano namespaces.

class.name: Namespace
class.description: Owns source instances and one output target. Namespace identities and legacy target paths survive migration.

class.name: Source
class.description: One configured source instance. A namespace can use multiple plugin types or multiple instances of one type. NONE bypasses ingestion.

class.name: Service
class.description: Shared listener, collector, plugin discovery and state defaults. Provider-specific credentials stay outside public examples.

class.name: TimelineTab
class.description: Selects an existing namespace. All is synthesized by the UI; it is not a third GEO namespace.

class.name: SourcePolicy
class.description: Scheduling is separate from conversion. Interval is a delay after completion; overlap is skipped. Streaming uses one persistent subscription.

class.name: PluginManifest
class.description: Public API contract for an independently built package. A package may implement source and converter roles together.

class.name: PluginInstallation
class.description: A local wheel, JAR or executable installed independently. Visibility metadata does not implement publication exclusion.

class.name: PluginRegistry
class.description: Discovers configured installations at startup, rejects ambiguous IDs and incompatible APIs, and reports unavailable plugins.

class.name: SourceAdapter
class.description: Reads files, HTTP, S3, SQL, MQTT or Kafka and returns payloads with source identity and checkpoint candidates.

class.name: Converter
class.description: Transforms payloads into compatible timeline records. Uses shared runtime services for validation, state and output.

class.name: BuildArtifact
class.description: Public packages use an explicit allowlist. Private plugin code, operational configuration and generated data stay outside releases.

class.name: StandaloneCLI
class.description: Runs an installed converter with --workspace and optional namespace/source selectors; no running collector server is required.

class.name: CollectorUI
class.description: Localhost and CSRF protected start, cancel, run again and schedule actions. Opening the page does not start another worker.

class.name: CollectorCore
class.description: Public timeline_data_collector. UI and standalone entry points share configuration, plugin contracts and the runner.

class.name: JobRequest
class.description: One immutable execution request. Force reprocesses selected inputs; it does not implicitly reset streaming checkpoints.

class.name: Job
class.description: A run has a unique ID and reports progress per source. Terminal outcomes retain the last valid published data.

class.name: RunLease
class.description: Cross-process exclusion covers CLI, UI and scheduler using the canonical output target plus namespace/source identity.

class.name: User
class.description: One role and one group per user. admin is the requested administrator flag, formerly written adman.

class.name: Role
class.description: A role limits the maximum namespace permission available through the user's group.

class.name: Group
class.description: Users share a group; permissions are assigned for each namespace through GroupNamespaceAccess.

class.name: GroupNamespaceAccess
class.description: Unique groupId + namespaceId. No assignment means denied. Explicit denied cannot be bypassed by User.admin.

class.name: ControlPermission
class.description: Collector actions require localhost, an allowed Host and Origin, and a per-process CSRF token. Use an authenticated tunnel for remote access.

class.name: RecordBatch
class.description: Existing sessions, events, activities and zones remain compatible. Provenance can live in sidecar metadata without changing record IDs.

class.name: Publisher
class.description: The shared writer validates, deduplicates, merges by source ownership and commits an atomic generation before advancing state.

class.name: Generation
class.description: An immutable generation plus an atomic publication step prevents readers seeing partial JSON and retains last-good data after failure.

class.name: Checkpoint
class.description: State advances only after durable output where the connector supports it. Offset, watermark or checksum state is private.

class.name: Dataset
class.description: Materialized JSON is served by both timeline backends. Static reviewed samples and live generated output are distinct datasets.

class.name: SourceStatus
class.description: Makes unavailable plugins and failed sources visible; includes last successful publication and counts.

class.name: DisplayModel
class.description: Existing timeline UI model JSON. This is distinct from the HBDS domain diagram and from an output target path.

class.name: TimelineAPI
class.description: Existing Java or Python backend reads published JSON independently of converter installation.

class.name: TimelineView
class.description: Preserves sessions/events, descriptors, colors, zones, navigation and All/namespace buttons. GEO opens with both namespaces.

class.name: DemoCatalog
class.description: The existing demos/catalog.json remains a display catalog. Adding a plugin does not implicitly add a catalog entry.

class.name: RegressionEvidence
class.description: Release gate covering record parity, both APIs, UI, restarts, streaming, private exclusions and Windows installation.

class.name: Release
class.description: Publish 2.9 as v2.9.0 only after implementation and regression gates pass. Preserve historical tags.
